front-01.jpg.why: A carries the Black Tiger bar sign and red-lit curtained window rooms; B swaps in an unnamed fascia and flat purple panels.

front-03.jpg.why: B's red-lit rooms with curtains behind dark glass read like the photo; A's solid red slabs do not.

front-04.jpg.why: Panels are identical; both miss the STACH deli front.

front-05.jpg.why: Panels are identical close-ups of a blank wall; neither shows the red bar front.

front-06.jpg.why: B gives the corner bar its BUHRS fascia and warm café interior; A leaves a generic blue fascia.

front-07.jpg.why: Centre fronts are identical; A's dark bar front at left suits the photo better than B's teal fascia.

front-09.jpg.why: B's script Green House sign over a warmly lit coffeeshop interior is closer to the dark lit café than A's plain shelves.

front-10.jpg.why: Both show a green Supermarkt where the photo has a black shuttered coffeeshop; neither is close.

front-11.jpg.why: The photo shows closed shutters and a clothing SALE sign; both panels show a souvenir shop.

front-12.jpg.why: A's dark OP DAM front with pendant lights and bottles matches the dark lamp-lit shop at right; B's plain red-orange fascia does not.

front-13.jpg.why: B's open kiosk shows stocked goods like the photo's open stall; A's glazing is empty and dark.

front-14.jpg.why: The blue supermarket fronts are effectively identical.

front-15.jpg.why: Both panels are bare brick; neither shows Café Lange Leo.

front-16.jpg.why: Neither matches the photo's black-framed reflective glass; A's dark interior is closer than B's bright souvenir racks.

front-17.jpg.why: The photo has plain light-framed glass and no red sign; A's red SNACKPOINT fascia is invented.

front-18.jpg.why: B shows the Bodycult tattoo shop with flash sheets; A's shelved shop could be any business.

front-19.jpg.why: The photo's right shop is a plain white-framed PC-support front; A puts a black INDO TATTOO front there.

front-20.jpg.why: The photo is too blurred to judge the Febo; the panels differ only in hatch detail.

front-21.jpg.why: The photo shows an ivy-covered stone building with no readable shopfront to compare.

front-23.jpg.why: A's eethuis shows a kebab and menu display like the photo's snack bar; B's window is empty.

front-24.jpg.why: A shows a clothing store with garments behind dark glass like The Sting; B has a blue awning and bookshelves.

front-25.jpg.why: Panels are identical blank glass; neither shows the Heineken bar.

front-26.jpg.why: A has the Salsa Shop sign and lit counter; B has no shop at all (the photo's fascia is dark, not white).

front-27.jpg.why: A has the red Uniqlo sign and clothing display; B shows a blue awning and a house door.

front-28.jpg.why: A gives the centre a café interior and the left bakery goods, though its Starbucks sign is wrong; B is empty glass under a yellow awning.

front-29.jpg.why: The photo is scaffolding and a truck; no shopfront to compare.

front-30.jpg.why: Near-identical generic fronts; neither shows the shuttered Manfield or dark Miracle front.

front-32.jpg.why: A's lamp-lit coffeeshop interior and bakery goods at Lambe suit the photo better than B's empty glass; both miss Papillon's dark mural front.

front-33.jpg.why: The photo's red-trimmed white shop has dark, empty glass; A fills it with a busy butcher display.

front-35.jpg.why: The photo is a quiet residential ground floor; B's dark glass is closer than A's lit shop interior.

front-36.jpg.why: The photo is too blurred to judge the distant tabak.

front-37.jpg.why: A's display counter echoes the photo's bakery counter; B's window is blank.
